messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR 4821 failed the SAST gate in CI. shows a high severity alert that looks like an AWS KMS key usage pattern flagged for hardcoded ARN. I think it's a false positive but need to confirm before unblocking release. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821

samir: linking the scan output? can you paste the snippet? sometimes our scanner flags policy ARNs in test fixtures.

maya: pasted the relevant snippet from the tool:
```
findings:
 - id: RKH-2025
   severity: high
   location: infra/tests/kms_fixture.go:12
   evidence: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12"
```
I think it's only used in a unit test, not deployed config.

olivia: sec-bot also posted a comment: "Snyk SAST: 1 high, 3 medium". sec-bot: please confirm whether this should block release or be ticketed for triage. :robot_face:

sec-bot: Automated note — SAST report uploaded to: https://security.redwood/snyk/reports/4821. Suggested action: triage and mark as test-fixture or suppress with policy ID "sast:suppression:test-fixture" if confirmed.

dmitri: If it's a test fixture we should suppress with a short justification and link to the test file. But per secure-SDLC we need an audit entry and reviewer signoff (at least one security approver) before suppression.

maya: agreed. proposal: create SEC-523 to track triage/suppression, include the evidence, add JIRA link in PR, then request @samir for reviewer signoff. Also question: does the suppression touch RBAC? the suppression will be a code comment plus Snyk policy file — no infra RBAC changes. However the unit test references a KMS key ARN; does that need to be stripped from repo?

samir: prefer to scrub any real-looking ARNs from test fixtures. Use faker arn or use environment var in tests. I'll submit a quick patch to replace the literal with `fake:kms:key` pattern.

olivia: also capture audit logging requirement: if we ever re-enable a real KMS key we must ensure CloudTrail captures decryption/GenerateDataKey usage and that logs are forwarded to the security log pipeline (retention 1y). Add a checklist item in SEC-523: "Ensure CloudTrail + KMS key usage logging enabled + SIEM alert for key policy changes."

maya: added checklist in SEC-523 with those items. tagging @dmitri to do the reviewer signoff after Samir's scrub PR.

dmitri: will take reviewer duty after Samir pushes. Also quick Q: we have a DAST job flakiness with auth redirects in staging, it's bitrotting our gate. Should we move DAST to nightly and keep SAST as PR-blocking?

samir: yes — move DAST to nightly and run a lightweight smoke DAST in PRs (login flow only). Full scan nightly. I'll open infra change PR to update CircleCI config.

olivia: +1. Make sure nightly scans are tagged in the ticket and the cadence is documented: nightly @ 02:00 UTC, report to #eng-security and attach failing URLs to SEC-523 when relevant.

sec-bot: Note — RBAC change request detected in PR 4819 (infra config) granting scan-service read access to KMS key metadata. This needs a threat model note and a short audit entry before approval.

maya: thanks sec-bot. FYI I don't think we need scan-service to access key material — only metadata. we should scope to DescribeKey only and ensure there is no Decrypt/GenerateDataKey permission. Samir please verify the IAM policy in PR 4819.

samir: will update to DescribeKey-only and attach policy diff. Also I'll add a KMS integration note in SEC-523 describing minimal perms and HSM/KMS key alias naming convention (alias/redwood/scan/*).

dmitri: final step: once suppression + scrub + IAM tweak are merged, I'll add the approval comment and mark the vulnerability as triaged in the tracker. then we can re-run CI and merge.

maya: perfect. timeline: Samir will push scrub + IAM update today, I will update SEC-523 with checklist, dmitri will sign off once green. If anything blocks, escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
